This vertical editorial illustration depicts a man’s torso and head against a patterned light-beige background with a red vertical stripe on the left. The man, with short dark hair and a tan complexion, wears a black suit and a black turtleneck. He holds a gold-colored smartphone in both hands, looking down at it with wide eyes and his mouth partially covered by one hand. A black watch is visible on his left wrist.

Overlaid on the man and background are multiple gray speech-bubble-shaped boxes containing text: “+62 813 335**** left group”, “+62 812 2964**** left group”, “+62 899 994**** left group”, and “Papa you are now administrator”. A larger white box on the left reads “+62 899 994**** BYE-BYE SETYA”.

At the top, large white letters spell “TEMPO”. Smaller text reads “WAWANCARA KHUSUS FETHULLAH GULEN” and “AKAL-AKALAN SEKOLAH YOHANES SURYA”. The bottom includes a barcode, “00022”, “24-30 JULI 2017”, “RP 45.000”, “KWAL.TEMPO.CO”, and “MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN”. A circular gray button with a downward arrow is in the bottom right.
